pages.text: Jim Raynor holds the bridge of the Hyperion high in the stratosphere over the terran base.

A grenade and a call to the Hyperion (a Yamato blast). At 2/3 health he calls marines, a marauder and a ghost; at 1/3 he rages and calls more.$(br2)$(l)Reward$(): Raynor's Helmet, the rest of a terran suit, the $(l)terran part of the artifact's key$(), 16 shards, 8 diamonds.
